items.reason: Bevacizumab is a D6 established GBM therapy, and its new route is part of the trial question ('Super-Selective Intraarterial Infusion of Erbitux (Cetuximab) and Avastin (Bevacizumab)'). That puts it under rule 6, not a candidate. Cetuximab is then the only investigational agent, so experimental_monotherapy (rule 4).

note: Candidate status is the same under either reading: cetuximab is a candidate whether bevacizumab is rule 6 or a combination partner. Cetuximab keeps formulation_flag new_route (intra-arterial). SIACI is a catheter route, not a C12 device activation, so device_dependent stays false. Priority-3 regimen_id: both agents are one named regimen, so a shared ID (coder A) is acceptable. Population is under 22 years (CHILD+ADULT): mixed_age.
